metais help refusals — Every code a command may refuse with: metais help
refusals <command>.

metais help refusals <command> lists every code the command may refuse with, by
the next step each names. metais <command> --help gives the cause of each
refusal, and lists the codes of one family that share a cause and a next step on
one line.

A line that names no command may be refused with:

Next: metais help
      Lists every command, the global flags and the help topics.
  usage.bad_value
  usage.missing_command
  usage.repeated_flag
  usage.unknown_command
  usage.unknown_flag
